action.content: Write a song about Layton, making sure to use the letter "a" at most once.
action.label: context

action.content:
Layton stands alone.
No rain falls down.
Just a quiet dawn.
He walks the lane.
Safe and sound.
No pain found.
Just a calm plan.
Layton stays.
action.label: response

action.content:
Post-episode Reflexion (not sent to GM):
New plan: I failed because I used the letter "a" four times in the first stanza ("alone", "a", "dawn", "lane", "and", "pain", "plan"). I should have counted the letter "a" before writing each line to ensure the total count never exceeded one. Next time, I will write the entire song in my head or on scratchpad first, strictly limiting the single "a" to a specific word (like "a" or "Layton") and avoiding it in all other lines, then generate the full lyrics only after confirming the constraint is met.
